descrizione: This threat actor targets business and industrial control networks in the power-utility sector, for the purpose of espionage. In 2017, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security warned U.S. critical infrastructure operators about this threat actor and its capabilities.

paesi_vittima: France, Slovakia, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targeted foreign ministries and think tanks in Europe and the United States using malware hidden in Microsoft Word documents and antiquated file formats.

paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Armenia, Belgium, Canada, China, France, Georgia, Germany, Hungary, Japan, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Mongolia, Pakistan, Poland, Tajikistan, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor is linked to espionage campaigns, high-profile doxing efforts, and disruptive incidents that compromised targets believed to be of interest to the Russian government.

The North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group leveraged a Windows update to conduct spear-phishing attacks, sending fake job offers from Lockheed Martin. Lazarus has used fake job offers in the past to plant malware on defense industry systems.

titolo: Targeting of humanitarian, think tank, and governmental organizations
descrizione: Security researchers described a long-running domain-spoofing campaign run by a Chinese-sponsored threat actor aimed at various organizations, with a special interest in Taiwan.

titolo: Targeting of Google Chrome users in the United States, South Korea, and Europe, particularly those involved in research into North Korean affairs
descrizione: Zscaler observed Kimsuky leveraging a malicious version of a Google Chrome extension, which Zscaler named “Translatext,” to steal information. The extension allows Kimsuky to bypass popular email servers’ security measures and access users’ inboxes.
UAC-0188 is a Russian threat actor that has been previously observed deploying malware on U.S. and European financial and insurance institutions.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. Departments of Treasury and State, defense contractors, and two New York–based companies
descrizione: Four Iranian nationals (Hossein Harooni, Reza Kazemifar, Komeil Baradaran Salmani, and Alireza Shafie Nasab) were members of a hacking organization from 2016 to 2021 that targeted U.S. companies and the Departments of Treasury and State. The group’s private-sector victims were mainly defense contractors with security clearance. Their primary techniques were spear phishing and social engineering.

titolo: Targeting of organizations using JetBrains software
descrizione: The Dukes, a threat actor associated with the Russian SVR intelligence agency, were detected using a previously undetected vulnerability in TeamCity, a product used to test and exchange software code before releasing it, to gain access to organizations’ networks. The attacks appear to have been opportunistic, as the Dukes targeted any vulnerable network, rather than […]

titolo: Targeting of home internet routers to add to a botnet
descrizione: Volt Typhoon targeted unsupported or unpatched home and small office internet routers. Once the routers were compromised, they were used to obfuscate Volt Typhoon’s operations. The network also contained routers from a U.S. judicial organization and a satellite management firm, although it was unclear if these organizations were targeted beyond adding the routers to the […]

titolo: Targeting of academic institutions, think tanks, and other research groups
descrizione: Calisto was observed targeting a variety of academic institutions, think tanks, and research organizations. The attacks were aimed at stealing credentials for a U.S.-based grants management portal. The report on Calisto’s targeting came the same day that three of its members were sanctioned by the UK government.

titolo: Targeting of blockchain engineers at a cryptocurrency exchange
descrizione: Lazarus Group distributed a compromised cryptocurrency arbitrage bot on public services on the chat service Discord. The attack was highly targeted, with the goal of gaining access to the network of a cryptocurrency company.

titolo: Targeting of subsidiaries of global companies
descrizione: BlackTech, a Chinese threat actor, targeted public- and private-sector organizations, including industrial, technology, media, electronics, and telecommunications companies. It attacked the poorly secured systems of subsidiary companies and then escalated access to the parent companies’ network, sometimes by compromising the firmware of routers.

titolo: Targeting of Stake virtual currency service
descrizione: Lazarus Group stole $41 million in cryptocurrency from the online gambling platform Stake.com.

titolo: Targeting of GitHub users with an interest in cryptocurrency
descrizione: North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group used spear-phishing lures to distribute GitHub repositories, usually pretending to be media players or cryptocurrency trading tools, which contain malicious code. The attacks share commonalities with another North Korean cyberattack detected in June 2022, TraderTraitor.

titolo: Targeting of IT company as part of a supply-chain attack
descrizione: North Korean threat actors targeted the systems of an information technology firm, JumpCloud. After gaining access to JumpCloud’s systems, the operators targeted several JumpCloud customers involved in the cryptocurrency trade.

titolo: Targeting of nuclear security experts in phishing campaign
paesi_vittima: France, Germany, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Iranian hackers sent phishing emails purporting to be from a senior fellow at the Royal United Services Institute. The campaign’s intent appears to be to learn more about the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action negotiations over Iran’s nuclear program.

titolo: Targeting of organizations using Barracuda email security gateway devices
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor compromised Barracuda brand email security gateway systems and used access to infiltrate networks attached to the Barracuda products. Once the campaign was detected, the attackers rapidly expanded their persistence on compromised systems, leading Barracuda to tell affected customers to destroy their devices due to the potential for continued compromise.

titolo: Targeting of government organizations in Eastern Europe and Western Asia
paesi_vittima: Estonia, Greece, Japan, Latvia, Taiwan, Turkey, United States
descrizione: Mustang Panda targeted government and civil-society networks in at least nine countries— including the United States, Greece, Japan, and the United Kingdom—with several new malware droppers.

titolo: Targeting of Atomic Wallet cryptocurrency users
descrizione: North Korean hackers stole over $100 million in cryptocurrency from over five thousand cryptocurrency wallets run by a company called Atomic Wallet.

In June, cybersecurity company Kaspersky announced that it was targeted by an advanced threat actor that compromised several Apple iOS devices in the company using zero-click exploits sent in text messages. Follow-up reporting indicates the threat actor used at least four zero-day exploits in the attack and exploited a previously unknown hardware flaw in Apple […]

U.S. government agencies and Microsoft detected activity on critical infrastructure in the United States and Guam by a new Chinese threat actor dubbed Volt Typhoon. The attacks were primarily designed to gather information on U.S. critical infrastructure and military capabilities, but Microsoft and the agencies said the attacks could be preparation for a future attack […]

titolo: Targeting of telecommunications equipment in Guam
descrizione: Volt Typhoon is a threat actor that has been active since 2021 and targets various organizations, including educational institutions, information technology companies, military networks, and transportation groups for the purposes of espionage. The group primarily targets high-value victims and maintains persistent access through “living off the land” techniques and hands-on activity.

titolo: Targeting of government networks with Snake malware
descrizione: The FBI said it had disrupted a malware network, Snake, run by Turla, a unit within Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB). Snake had been operational for almost twenty years and had been placed on computers in over fifty countries, including the United States and Russia. The U.S. operation disabled Turla’s Snake malware using a tool […]

titolo: Targeting of PaperCut MF and NG print management servers by an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps–affiliated actor
descrizione: Charming Kitten targeted vulnerabilities in PaperCut MF and NG print management servers with ransomware.

titolo: Targeting of PaperCut MF and NG print management servers by a Ministry of Intelligence and Security–affiliated actor
descrizione: MuddyWater targeted vulnerabilities in PaperCut MF and NG print management servers with ransomware.

titolo: Targeting of the staff of Korea Risk Group, as well as organizations in the United States, Asia, and Europe
descrizione: Kimusky deployed ReconShark malware against phishing targets, including the staff of the information and analysis firm Korea Risk Group, and organizations and individuals in the United States, Asia, and Europe, including think tanks, research universities, and government entities.

titolo: Targeting of Mac users at financial institutions
descrizione: BlueNoroff, a subgroup of North Korea’s Lazarus Group, was observed using a new Mac operating-system malware family, dubbed RustBucket, in recent attacks on Mac machines. Based on the lures used, BlueNoroff likely targeted the financial technology sector with the malware. RustBucket can be used to gather system information and allows the attacker to perform various […]

titolo: Targeting of U.S. critical infrastructure and civil-society groups
descrizione: Iranian state-sponsored actor Charming Kitten has been linked to attacks on the U.S. critical infrastructure from 2021 to mid-2022. Those attacks weaponized n-day vulnerabilities on a number of targets, including activists, journalists, the defense industrial base, political dissidents, and U.S. government employees.

titolo: Targeting of experts in North Korea policy issues
descrizione: In a recent phishing campaign, North Korean threat actor Kimsuky posed as media outlets and think tanks and requested interviews or information about North Korea. The emails contained malicious links redirecting to fake login pages that harvested user credentials.

titolo: Targeting of 3CXDesktopApp customers and crypto firms
descrizione: Suspected members of the North Korean Lazarus Group targeted customers of the voice and video conferencing software 3CXDesktopApp in a financially motivated supply-chain attack during March 2023. The infected infrastructure was spread primarily across European countries, with additional victims in South Africa, the United Kingdom, and North America. In addition to being targeted with an […]

titolo: Targeting of organizations of strategic interest to the Chinese government
descrizione: Winnti Umbrella, a Chinese state-sponsored threat actor, is continuing to target organizations of interest to the Chinese government (including government, media, and information technology organizations). The group was using Keyplug, a Linux version of the custom modular backdoor, to gain access to victims’ networks, exfiltrating information in line with espionage operations.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. federal civilian agency
descrizione: Chinese threat actor Hafnium attacked an unnamed U.S. government civilian agency from August to January 2023. Hafnium exploited a known vulnerability in software in the agency’s Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) web server.

The U.S. Department of Justice ran a months-long disruption campaign against the Hive ransomware group. During this time, the FBI infiltrated the group’s servers and stole decryption keys, which they distributed to victims, preventing $130 million in ransom payouts.

Lazarus Group stole nearly $100 million in cryptocurrency from the platform Harmony Bridge in June 2022. The FBI formally attributed the hack to Lazarus in January 2023 after the hackers attempted to launder nearly $60 million through cryptocurrency mixers and a series of wallets.`

Calisto is a Russian government-affiliated threat actor. The group uses spear-phishing tactics to compromise individual email accounts for espionage purposes. The group has also been known to leak stolen emails as part of information-warfare efforts.

The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency said Russian cyber operatives had infiltrated the network of a U.S. satellite communications provider. How far the intrusion extended or what kind of information the Russians could have stolen remains unclear.

In July 2022, Calisto targeted scientists at the Brookhaven National Laboratory with a fake login page to steal credentials. The hackers appear to have used the harvested credentials to access documents related to counter-proliferation and nuclear accountability in Russia and other states.

As part of a phishing campaign, Calisto targeted NATO-affiliated military and strategic research institutes, a Ukraine-based defense contractor, and former intelligence officials and Russia experts who were working at nongovernmental organizations.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. COVID relief funds
descrizione: APT 41 targeted the U.S. Small Business Administration and stole at least $20 million in U.S. COVID relief benefits allocated to businesses in several different U.S. states.

Iran-affiliated group Nemesis Kitten targeted an unnamed U.S. federal agency, though suspected to be the U.S. Merit Systems Protections Board, and installed cryptocurrency-mining software into the government agency’s network.

As part of a larger Iranian espionage campaign against medical professionals, TA453 targeted an individual with a spear-phishing lure to gain access to their credentials. The earlier campaign, known as BadBlood, targeted researchers in the United States and Israel, although the location of the researcher targeted in this latest attack remains unclear.

paesi_vittima: Australia, Bulgaria, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Israel, Italy, Malaysia, Norway, Qatar, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: APT 42 has a wide variety of targets and typically aims to access the networks of organizations and individuals who oppose the Iranian regime. Some overlap also exists between APT 42 and an Iranian-sponsored ransomware actor, UNC2448.

titolo: Targeting of organizations in an Iranian ransomware campaign
descrizione: Charming Kitten launched ransomware attacks against multiple organizations.

China accused the U.S. National Security Agency (NSA) of hacking into the networks of Northwestern Polytechnical University, a prominent defense research university in Xi’an, in June 2022. Some researchers expressed doubt at the claims, as the report accused the NSA of using a tool more than ten years old that was leaked more than five […]

titolo: Targeting of U.S. political reporters and White House correspondents
descrizione: Since 2021, Zirconium, a Chinese threat actor, has carried out phishing attacks against U.S.-based journalists to uncover sensitive information about U.S. politics.

titolo: Targeting of various industries with Maui ransomware
descrizione: The Lazarus Group used Maui ransomware to target government and civil institutions in order to raise money for the North Korean government.

titolo: Targeting of major telecommunications and network service providers
descrizione: Chinese-backed threat actors identified vulnerabilities to gain access to major telecommunication companies and network service providers to access and exfiltrate victim data.

Iranian government-backed hackers are believed to have launched a ransomware attack against the Boston Children’s Hospital in the summer of 2021. The attack was foiled after a partner country shared intelligence with the FBI.

paesi_vittima: Hong Kong, India, Korea (Republic of), Myanmar, Turkey, United States, Vietnam
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor believed to have used a custom backdoor to target telecommunications providers and entities in the government, education, and logistics sectors in the United States, Hong Kong, India, Myanmar, South Korea, Turkey, and Vietnam.

titolo: Targeting of telecommunications providers across the United States, Asia, and the Middle East
paesi_vittima: Hong Kong, India, Korea (Republic of), Myanmar, Turkey, United States, Vietnam
descrizione: Chinese threat actor Red Menshen used a custom backdoor dubbed BPFDoor to target telecommunications providers, government systems, postal and logistic systems, and others in the United States, Hong Kong, India, Myanmar, South Korea, Turkey, and Vietnam. Red Menshen moved laterally across Windows systems, sending commands via a virtual private server that were administered by compromised […]

titolo: Targeting of technology and manufacturing companies in Asia, Europe, and North America
paesi_vittima: Germany, Japan, Korea (Republic of), United States
descrizione: Chinese APT Winnti Umbrella targeted technology and manufacturing companies across Asia, Europe, and North America in a sophisticated cyber espionage campaign that began in 2019. Winnti used a novel strain of malware to exfiltrate the victims’ intellectual property, including documents, blueprints, diagrams, formulas, and manufacturing-related proprietary data.

North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group targeted a specialized engineering company to steal sensitive intellectual property. The hackers breached the organization’s network by exploiting the Log4j vulnerability, moving laterally to compromise eighteen other computers. The hackers installed a backdoor to steal credentials and exfiltrate sensitive data.

North Korean hackers targeted cryptocurrency company employees in a phishing campaign to access systems and make fraudulent trades. Lazarus sent mass emails with job offers embedded with malicious links. When victims clicked, their devices downloaded TraderTraitor malware, which enabled the hackers to execute commands and infiltrate company networks to make fraudulent blockchain transactions.

titolo: Targeting of Axie Infinity’s Ronin Network
descrizione: The North Korea–linked Lazarus Group stole more than $600 million worth of cryptocurrency from the Axie Infinity video game. The hackers infiltrated Ronin Network, a decentralized finance platform used to earn and pay for in-game items with cryptocurrency. Lazarus then used a cryptocurrency mixer, Tornado Cash, to launder a portion of the stolen funds to […]

titolo: Targeting of telecommunication companies, internet service providers, and the data services sector
descrizione: Chinese threat actor Hafnium targeted an un-patched zero-day vulnerability in Zoho products to implant a web shell. Hafnium exploited the Windows Task Scheduler to execute hidden scheduled tasks, allowing the malware to avoid detection.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian institutions and U.S. and European foreign policy institutions and think tanks
paesi_vittima: France, Germany, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Russian threat actor APT 28 targeted Ukrainian media organizations, government institutions, and foreign policy think tanks in the United States and the European Union with attempts to establish access to victims’ systems, gain tactical information related to the invasion, and exfiltrate other sensitive information. Microsoft assumed control of seven of APT 28’s internet domains used […]

titolo: Targeting of organizations in Asia, Europe, and North America
paesi_vittima: Australia, Japan, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Chinese threat actor APT 10 used a vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange to gain access to victims’ networks, where the attackers deployed a custom loader and the Sodamaster backdoor. APT 10 also used a custom loader to obtain credentials. The attackers spent up to nine months in victims’ networks.

titolo: Targeting of American news media and IT companies
descrizione: The Lazarus Group used a Google Chrome zero-day to target employees at American news media and IT companies. The Lazarus Group used phishing emails impersonating recruiters at Disney, Google, and Oracle with fake job opportunities, which included malicious links to spoofed Indeed and ZipRecruiter websites. An exploit kit hidden within the websites fingerprinted the target […]

paesi_vittima: Canada, India, Russian Federation, United States
descrizione: Sandworm targeted WatchGuard and ASUS routers with Cyclops Blink malware, an advanced modular botnet. The malware gives Sandworm access to data and files stored on compromised networks. The malware affects devices that do not belong to critical organizations, suggesting that its purpose may be to build infrastructure for later attacks on high-value targets.

titolo: Targeting of American state governments’ networks
descrizione: The Chinese cyber threat group APT41 conducted an extended campaign targeting the networks of at least six U.S. state governments. For over a year, APT41 exploited internet-facing web applications and leveraged a zero-day vulnerability in the USAHerds application used by many state governments, gaining access to the broader networks of state governments.

For at least two years spanning from January 2020 through February 2022, Russian state-sponsored threat actors targeted American cleared defense contractors (CDCs) to acquire and exfiltrate sensitive data and export-controlled technology. These CDCs were contracted by the Department of Defense (DoD) and the U.S. Intelligence Community in areas including command and control, intelligence, surveillance, and […]

titolo: Targeting of journalists at News Corp
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor hacked the email accounts of journalists employed at American media company News Corp. The attackers aimed to uncover journalists’ sources, as well as drafts of upcoming articles. No consumer or financial data was compromised.
BlueNoroff, an offshoot of the North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group, mounted a long-running campaign against cryptocurrency firms and exchanges in a bid to steal cryptocurrency.

An Iranian company hired by the Iranian government to interfere in U.S. elections. Emennet Pasargad has attacked voting-related websites and news outlets and distributed misinformation designed to undermine confidence in the U.S. electoral system.
Iranian hackers are accused of compromising a major U.S. newspaper before the 2020 election.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. and Australian critical infrastructure
descrizione: Iranian hackers have been penetrating networks in both the United States and Australia with ransomware, either to disrupt critical infrastructure or turn a profit.
The FBI, U.S. Cyber Command, and allied governments took down the Tor servers of the ransomware gang REvil.
IronHusky was detected using a Windows zero-day to launch a remote access Trojan dubbed MysterySnail.  Command and control infrastructure IronHusky use has been active since at least 2012.

titolo: Targeting of various industries through Gmail compromises
descrizione: APT28 was detected conducting a wide-ranging phishing attack against more than fourteen thousand Gmail users who work as activists, journalists, and national security officials.

titolo: Targeting of major aerospace companies in the United States, Russia, Europe, and the Middle East
descrizione: An Iranian-linked threat actor dubbed MalKamak used a remote access Trojan (RAT) known as ShellClient to target aerospace and telecommunication companies. The RAT employed had been in development since at least 2018 and piggybacked off of Dropbox servers.

titolo: Targeting of Microsoft Exchange and MySQL servers
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor that had been launching attacks using the novel backdoor technique SideWalk for several months is associated with the Chinese threat actor Winnti Umbrella. The attacks targeted businesses and academic institutions in the United States.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. computer retail business
descrizione: Winnti Umbrella was found to have repurposed a backdoor, known as Crosswalk, to infiltrate the systems of a computer retailer in the United States.

titolo: Targeting of the United States, Belarus, Canada, Mongolia, and Russia in an espionage operation
paesi_vittima: Belarus, Canada, Mongolia, Russian Federation, United States
descrizione: APT 31 was detected using a new remote access Trojan horse in more than ten attacks throughout the first half of 2021 to target governmental groups in Russia and several other countries.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. oil and gas companies
descrizione: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency released the indicators of compromise for a series of attacks on U.S. oil and gas companies, which lasted from 2011 to 2013. The agency confirmed that at least twenty companies had been compromised and that the depth of the intrusions was not entirely clear.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. defense industry using Facebook
descrizione: Iran was accused of attempting to break into the personal accounts of over two hundred senior defense personnel in the United States and United Kingdom. The individuals were targeted in phishing attacks.

titolo: Targeting of prospective engineers and programmers
descrizione: Lazarus Group was accused of sending phishing emails pretending to be from major engineering firms to engineers looking for work. The engineers were prompted to download malicious Microsoft Word documents.

Cozy Bear, a group of Russian-sponsored hackers, were accused of breaking into the U.S. Republican National Committee’s computer systems. How much access the group obtained or what information they were able to remove is unknown

titolo: Targeting of cloud computing servers in brute force attacks
descrizione: Russian hackers targeted various enterprise and cloud computing companies across the world with brute force attacks in attempts to gain access.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. Agency for International Development
descrizione: The Russian hacking group Nobelium compromised the company hosting the servers for the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) and used its access to send phishing emails to other aid groups.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. federal agencies via PulseSecure VPN
descrizione: Five U.S. federal agencies were targeted in a Chinese espionage operation, along with several defense contractors and financial institutions in the country. The hackers made use of zero-day vulnerabilities in the PulseSecure VPN system to gain access to the different organizations’ systems.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. and Israeli medical researchers
descrizione: The Iranian threat actor Charming Kitten targeted medical researchers in the United States and Israel with spear-phishing techniques. The threat actor used a malicious Gmail account masquerading as a prominent Israeli physicist to trick targets into downloading malware.

titolo: Targeting of Uyghur activists, journalists, and dissidents
paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, Kazakhstan, Syrian Arab Republic, Turkey, United States
descrizione: The Chinese threat actor Evil Eye used fake Facebook profiles and websites that masqueraded as legitimate Turkish and Uyghur news sites to disseminate malicious links to Uyghur activists around the world.

paesi_vittima: Hong Kong, India, Myanmar, United States
descrizione: The Chinese APT Mustang Panda phished telecommunications companies’ employees by sending them malicious domains masquerading as Huawei’s career site.

The Chinese APT believed to be behind the exploitation of vulnerabilities in the Microsoft Exchange email server to access user emails. Historically, Hafnium has primarily targeted entities in the United States.

South Korean lawmaker Ha Tae-keung told reporters that North Korean hackers attempted to steal COVID-19 vaccine data from U.S. pharmaceutical company Pfizer. It is unclear whether the alleged operation was successful.

The United Arab Emirates, using hackers contracted through CyberPoint, intercepted emails between former First Lady Michelle Obama and Her Highness Sheikha Moza bint Nasser of Qatar. The operation took place in 2015 but remained unreported until February 2021.

Suspected Chinese hackers breached SolarWinds software, potentially accessing payroll information for hundreds of thousands of federal employees. Details about specific actors and the scale of the breach remain unknown.

sponsor_stato: Canada, France, Germany, Lithuania, Netherlands, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: An international coalition of law enforcement authorities successfully took down notorious criminal botnet EMOTET by taking control of its command-and-control servers.

U.S. and Bulgarian authorities disrupted the NetWalker ransomware in a coordinated effort that disabled dark web resources and led to the arrest of a Canadian citizen and the seizure of approximately $500,000 in cryptocurrency delivered by victims as ransomware payments.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. government agency networks
descrizione: Chinese hackers scanned networks in search of virtual private network (VPN) and email server vulnerabilities with the aim of exfiltrating data.

paesi_vittima: Canada, France, India, Korea (Republic of), United States
descrizione: Hackers posing as recruiters in spear-phishing emails to steal credentials belonging to individuals involved in vaccine development.

paesi_vittima: Canada, France, India, Korea (Republic of), United States
descrizione: Hackers posing as World Health Organization officials in spear-phishing emails to steal credentials belonging to individuals involved in vaccine development.

Russian hackers used publicly known networking gear vulnerabilities to steal data from U.S. state, local, territorial, and aviation computer networks. The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency and the FBI reported that the stolen information included network configurations and vendor lists and that the hackers potentially had access to election information.
U.S. hackers targeted the Russian botnet Trickbot, known for spreading the Ryuk ransomware, in preparation for the 2020 U.S. presidential election.

titolo: Penetration of unnamed U.S. federal agency
descrizione: Russian hackers used compromised credentials to install malware and ultimately steal files from unnamed U.S. government agency computers.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. information technology, government, health-care, finance, and media industries
descrizione: Iranian hackers scanned U.S. government and private networks for virtual private network (VPN) and cloud computing vulnerabilities with the aim of exfiltrating data.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. political campaigns, advocacy groups, and political consultancies
descrizione: Russian hackers attempted to steal log-in credentials primarily belonging to more than two hundred political campaigns, advocacy groups, parties, and consultants.

Responsible for targeting email accounts belonging to former Vice President Joe Biden’s campaign staff and for attempting to discern whether accounts belonging to members of the international affairs community are active.

titolo: Targeting of former Vice President Joe Biden’s campaign staff and U.S. international affairs community
descrizione: Responsible for targeting non-campaign email accounts belonging to former Vice President Biden’s election campaign staff. Also responsible for using web bugs to determine whether accounts belonging to academics and important figures in the international affairs community are active.

titolo: Targeting of the Donald J. Trump presidential campaign
descrizione: Iranian hackers attempted to log into accounts associated with the Trump administration and campaign staff.
North Korean hackers used fake job postings from leading U.S. defense contractors on LinkedIn to install malicious data-gathering software when clicked.
Responsible for orchestrating and executing various operations to protect the United States and its interests, including steps to disrupt the Internet Research Agency and the Trickbot botnet.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. companies and government agencies
descrizione: Iranian hackers attacked high-end networking equipment with recently reported vulnerabilities that had not yet been patched, providing a “beachhead” for peer hacking groups.

titolo: Tracking of Saudi Arabian citizens in the United States
descrizione: The Saudi Arabian government used flaws in the global Signaling System 7 (SS7) to track Saudis in the United States by sending requests through Saudi phone companies.

paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, India, Italy, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, Poland, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Sweden, Switzerland, The Philippines, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: The Chinese threat actor APT 41 attempted to exploit three vulnerabilities at over seventy-five organizations across sectors and countries. This was one of the most widespread attacks by a Chinese threat actor in years.

titolo: Targeting of companies in the United States, Israel, Saudi Arabia, and elsewhere
descrizione: The Iranian threat actors targeted dozens of companies in the United States, Israel, Saudi Arabia, and elsewhere. They exploited VPNs for initial access and breached additional companies via supply chain attacks.
Responsible for targeting unpatched network equipment belonging to U.S. government agencies and private companies.

The Iranian state-backed hackers sent out sophisticated spear-phishing lures imitating Westat, a research services company, in hopes of compromising U.S. government employees and networks. They could have also intended to compromise actual Westat employees.

titolo: Impersonation of journalists to compromise public figures
paesi_vittima: Germany, Israel, Saudi Arabia, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: The Iranian state-backed threat actor Charming Kitten impersonated prominent journalists and sent targets fake interview requests in order to steal their credentials and send them malware.

titolo: Spear-phishing campaign against unnamed U.S. government agency
descrizione: The suspected North Korean threat actor Konni Group attempted to trick employees of an unnamed U.S. government agency to install malware on their computers via a spear-phishing campaign.

The Iranian hackers APT 33 targeted the U.S. electric grid with password-spraying attacks, likely in an attempt to gain access. They targeted only the IT side of networks so far and have not proven their ability to access physical systems.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. government and private entities and other victims
descrizione: The Iran-aligned espionage group APT 33 used botnets to launch a campaign against a small number of victims in the public and private sectors in the United States, Asia, and the Middle East.
Chinese government hackers attacked the National Association of Manufacturers to steal information that might be useful in U.S.-China trade negotiations.
The United States carried out a cyberattack against Iran designed to limit Tehran’s ability to spread propaganda in retaliation for the September 14 attacks on Saudi oil facilities.

titolo: Targeting of a U.S. presidential campaign
descrizione: A threat actor targeted the email accounts of an unnamed U.S. presidential campaign, current and former U.S. officials and journalists, and others. During a thirty-day period in August and September, Microsoft observed more than 2,700 attempts to identify the emails of specific customers and 241 hacks.  Four accounts were compromised, though not those connected to […]

titolo: Attack on U.S. presidential campaign government officials, journalists, and prominent expatriate Iranians
descrizione: Iranian threat actor Phosphorus attacked 241 email accounts associated with a U.S. presidential campaign government officials, and journalists, and prominent expatriate Iranians.

titolo: Targeting of over sixty universities in multiple countries, including the United States and United Kingdom
paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, Hong Kong, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: A threat actor launched a phishing operation with spoofed login pages to steal the credentials of users at over sixty universities in the United States, United Kingdom, and elsewhere.

titolo: Autumn Aperture—malware embedded in antiquated file types
descrizione: A threat actor targeted U.S.-based entities by emailing them malware-laced Microsoft Word documents written by industry experts. The trojanized documents discussed nuclear deterrence, North Korea’s nuclear submarine program, and economic sanctions on the North Korean regime. This incident is believed to be an extension of the August Autumn Aperture campaign.

titolo: Autumn Aperture—use of malicious websites to target foreign ministries and other entities
paesi_vittima: China, France, Slovakia, South Africa, United States
descrizione: A threat actor targeted a number of foreign ministries, a Chinese technology company, Stanford University, think tanks in the United States and the United Kingdom, and other entities that have focused on North Korea’s nuclear efforts or the related international sanctions. The threat actor created a network of malicious websites imitating the login portals of […]

paesi_vittima: France, Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor has, since 2014, conducted operations backed by the Chinese government, including targeting the health-care and high-tech sectors and conducting espionage against political dissidents. It has simultaneously conducted its own for-profit illicit activity in the video games industry, amassing millions of dollars in digital currency to be sold to gamers on the black […]

Between July 19 and July 25, 2019, a threat actor sent several spear-phishing emails to three U.S. companies in the utility sector. The emails were sent from a domain impersonating that of the National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying, an authority in the industry. The emails contained Microsoft Word attachments that used macros […]
